subject.title: feat(android): render LaTeX display math in chat via bundled KaTeX

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR require real Android visual proof before merge after the fallback fix, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The change is a user-visible Android rendering path backed by a WebView and bundled JS assets, and the PR itself says pixel rendering still needs an authorized device pass.

options.title: Require visual proof before merge
options.body: Fix the invalid-math fallback, then add a redacted Android emulator or device screenshot/recording showing rendered display math and fallback behavior.

options.title: Override proof after code fix
options.body: A maintainer can accept the unit/build evidence once the fallback bug is fixed, but that leaves real chat rendering unproven before merge.

options.title: Pause for device lane
options.body: Hold the PR until an authorized Android proof lane is available to capture the user-visible transcript behavior.

recommendation.title: Require visual proof before merge
recommendation.body: Fix the invalid-math fallback, then add a redacted Android emulator or device screenshot/recording showing rendered display math and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the current mobile polish follow-up context and has recent merged work across the Android chat and iOS math surfaces.
